en.headline: 385 own commits, 390 automated commits, and 19 PRs across OpenCode skills
en.teaser: A month of shipping OpenCode skills: asset-inventory reached v1.15.0, meld-deepresearch v0.4.0 and model-picker v1.4.0, while 59 issues mostly fed upstream bug reports.
en.overview:
### What was worked on

The window's centre of gravity was the author's own OpenCode skill repositories. `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` carried 136 own commits and 10 PRs and shipped 15 releases in quick succession, from v1.11.4 through v1.15.0. The releases record a documentation-site pass, a behavior-neutral token trim, a new 🛑broken state marker for assets that are registered but cannot be invoked, security guards for MCP probing, a release-prep script and docs-parity gate, install via skills.sh, and finally a registry-first host-command scan that enumerates the app bundle's own command registry instead of hunting for prose. PRs 4 through 8 show the earlier 1.5.0–1.7.0 line: Japanese glossary delivery, MCP enumeration and update.ps1 fixes, seven fixed-string languages, and a Material docs site with rendered samples.

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the profile repository, took 103 own commits plus 385 automated commits. Work there was on the GitHub profile itself: switching copy to English, replacing a chart note with peak and average summaries, adding a rolling 30-day activity card with a scheduled workflow, and fixing the daily report so its statistics and breakdown can no longer disagree. CI moved to checkout and setup-node v7 to leave the deprecated Node 20 runtime, and the daily workflow gained a manual date input.

`meld-deepresearch` saw 76 commits and 4 releases (v0.1.0 to v0.4.0). It grew from a single research skill into a family with two optional capability skills, added an observations evidence type and C1–C8 fixes, a validation and CI layer, a bilingual GitHub Pages landing page with light and dark themes, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping six gates.

### Skills, sandbox and supporting repos

`opencode-go-model-picker` (24 commits, 4 releases) reached v1.0.0 and then v1.4.0, adding a discover-agents script, a snapshot-summary script, proxy-aware and BOM-tolerant helpers, richer agent metadata, and an offline price seed with a two-question diagnostic. `opencode-skill-management` (24 commits, 1 release) implemented the skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable, corrected the plugin add entry-point conclusion, and published 0.1.0 rc builds through trusted publishing before v0.2.0. `opencode-agent-sandbox` (18 commits) built up an AGENTS.md and a knowledge archive covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls. Small commits landed in myBlog (three OpenChamber capture samples) and sopen-translate (repository init), and opencode-skill-creator received 5 automated commits.

### Upstream issues

Most of the 59 issues were filed upstream. `openchamber/openchamber` accounts for 30, covering the multi-run lifecycle (orphaned MCP processes blocking worktree removal), browser captures exported at 1x on high-DPI displays, context panel breakdown percentages, stale-save clobbering of AGENTS.md, and the v2.0.1 release missing update manifests. `anomalyco/opencode` accounts for 12, chiefly MiMo-V2.6-Flash image handling on the Go endpoint and a missing way to run the CLI from the Windows desktop build. Others went to OfficeCLI, vercel-labs/skills, SenseNova-Skills and oh-my-opencode-slim. In `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` the author opened eight PRs (39–42, 38 and 43 among the tracked items) and four issues; PRs 39–42 were closed on 2026-10-01. One PR went to VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills to list asset-inventory.

### Data notes

There are no missing days in the 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-21 window, and no reviews were recorded. Dates from 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-01 were reconstructed via GitHub Search and are approximate: star counts are unavailable and releases cover only the author's own repositories.

highlights.text: v1.7.0 PR merged, bringing seven languages, a Material docs site and rendered examples.
Host-command scan became registry-first, enumerating the bundle's own command registry.
Added proxy-aware and BOM-tolerant script helpers plus richer agent discovery metadata.
skill_management plugin ships list, inspect, disable and enable without touching skill files.
Deleting a multi-run leaves orphaned MCP child processes, so git worktree remove --force fails.
MiMo models advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image with 400.
Hardened eval robustness in parsing, aggregation and install; opened 2026-09-28 and closed 2026-10-01.
Introduced a thin meld.py CLI wrapping all six gates behind one --outdir.

zh.headline: 本人提交 385 次、自动提交 390 次，OpenCode 技能相关 PR 19 个
zh.teaser: 这个月主要在打磨 OpenCode 技能：asset-inventory 推进到 v1.15.0，meld-deepresearch 到 v0.4.0，model-picker 到 v1.4.0；59 个 issue 多为上游缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
### 主要工作方向

本窗口的重心是本人名下的 OpenCode 技能仓库。`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 有 136 次本人提交、10 个 PR 和 15 个发布版本，从 v1.11.4 一路发到 v1.15.0。发布说明记录了这些内容：文档站整理、不改变行为的 token 精简、新增用于「已注册但无法调用」资产的 🛑broken 状态标记、MCP 探测的安全护栏、release-prep 脚本与文档一致性检查、支持通过 skills.sh 安装，最后把宿主命令扫描改为先枚举应用包自带的命令注册表。PR 4 到 PR 8 对应更早的 1.5.0–1.7.0 线：日文词表交付、MCP 枚举与 update.ps1 修复、七种固定字符串语言、带渲染示例的 Material 文档站。

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 是个人主页仓库，有 103 次本人提交，另有 385 次自动提交。改动集中在 GitHub 主页本身：文案改为英文、用峰值与均值摘要替换图表说明、新增近 30 天活动卡片并配套定时工作流，修复日报使统计数字与拆分不再互相矛盾。CI 升级到 checkout 与 setup-node v7，摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时；日报工作流增加了手动指定日期的输入。

`meld-deepresearch` 有 76 次提交和 4 个发布版本（v0.1.0 到 v0.4.0）。它从单一研究技能扩展为三个协作技能，加入 observations 证据类型与 C1–C8 修复、校验脚本与 CI、明暗主题双语 GitHub Pages 落地页，以及把六道闸门封装成一个 --outdir 的轻量 `meld.py` 命令行。

### 技能、沙箱与辅助仓库

`opencode-go-model-picker`（24 次提交、4 个发布）先到 v1.0.0 再到 v1.4.0，新增 discover-agents 与 snapshot-summary 脚本、支持代理和 BOM 的辅助函数、更完整的 agent 元数据，以及离线价格种子和两问式诊断。`opencode-skill-management`（24 次提交、1 个发布）实现了 skill_management 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable，更正了 plugin add 入口结论，并通过 trusted publishing 发布 0.1.0 的 rc 版本后推出 v0.2.0。`opencode-agent-sandbox`（18 次提交）建立起 AGENTS.md 和知识归档，涵盖 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑。myBlog 提交了三个 OpenChamber 截图样例，sopen-translate 初始化了仓库，opencode-skill-creator 有 5 次自动提交。

### 上游 issue

59 个 issue 大多提交到上游。`openchamber/openchamber` 占 30 个，涉及多运行生命周期（残留 MCP 子进程导致 worktree 删除失败）、高 DPI 下浏览器截图只按 1 倍导出、上下文面板占比计算、AGENTS.md 被旧数据静默覆盖，以及 v2.0.1 缺少更新清单文件。`anomalyco/opencode` 占 12 个，主要是 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 在 Go 端点的图片处理问题，以及 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法调用。其余提交给 OfficeCLI、vercel-labs/skills、SenseNova-Skills 和 oh-my-opencode-slim。在 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 中提交了 8 个 PR（含 39–42 等）和 4 个 issue，其中 PR 39–42 于 2026-10-01 关闭。另有 1 个 PR 提交到 VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills 用于收录 asset-inventory。

### 数据说明

2026-09-22 至 2026-10-21 期间没有缺失数据的日子，也没有记录到评审。2026-09-22 至 2026-10-01 的数据通过 GitHub Search 重建，属于近似值：星数不可用，发布版本只覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: v1.7.0 的 PR 已合并，带来七种语言、Material 文档站和渲染示例。
宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先，直接枚举应用包自带的命令注册表。
新增支持代理与 BOM 的脚本辅助函数，并补充更完整的 agent 发现元数据。
skill_management 插件提供 list、inspect、disable、enable，且不改动技能文件。
删除多运行会残留 MCP 子进程，导致 git worktree remove --force 报权限错误。
MiMo 模型宣称支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对每张图片都返回 400。
加固评测在解析、聚合与安装环节的健壮性，2026-09-28 提交、2026-10-01 关闭。
推出轻量 meld.py 命令行，用一个 --outdir 封装全部六道闸门。
